description: A GitHub Pages-ready static showcase and documentation site for the existing ScrapeFlow project, featuring its capabilities, architecture at a safe high level, documentation links, and project presentation PDF.

services.name: Project showcase website
services.description: Static, responsive project portfolio/documentation website published with GitHub Pages.

questions.question: Which language should the showcase frontend use?
questions.rationale: TypeScript provides maintainable typed components while producing static assets suitable for GitHub Pages.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for a maintainable static site.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Plain JavaScript with no compile-time type checking.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should the showcase use?
questions.rationale: Astro can generate a lightweight static site that can be hosted on GitHub Pages.

options.label: Astro
options.description: Static-first site framework with minimal client-side JavaScript.

questions.question: What features should the showcase include?
questions.recommendedChoice: A responsive ScrapeFlow overview, selected capabilities and verified project highlights, links to SETUP.md and docs/FINAL_REPORT.md, a presentation/documentation section linking docs/presentation/README.md and the PDF, and GitHub Pages publishing guidance. Avoid reproducing secrets, private configuration, or operational deployment details.
questions.answer: A responsive ScrapeFlow overview, selected capabilities and verified project highlights, links to SETUP.md and docs/FINAL_REPORT.md, a presentation/documentation section linking docs/presentation/README.md and the PDF, and GitHub Pages publishing guidance. Avoid reproducing secrets, private configuration, or operational deployment details.
questions.rationale: This reflects the requested showcase and provided repository documentation while excluding sensitive setup details.

questions.question: Which data stores or storage services are required?
questions.rationale: The requested website is static and can link to repository-hosted documentation and the presentation PDF.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Static website with no persistence or file/object storage service.

questions.question: Should users sign in to use application features?
questions.rationale: A public static project showcase does not need application user accounts.

options.label: No
options.description: Public site with no signed-in application features.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users must sign in to access application features.
